reviews.text:
I've been to many animal hospitals, but this is by far the best.

They are kind to both pet owners and animals, and the fees are reasonable.

I'm moving a little further away soon, but I plan to continue going there as much as possible.

I was looking for a regular veterinarian for my dog, who will soon be 12 years old, and this hospital was recommended to me. Each appointment was 30 minutes long, and they patiently answered all my questions and addressed my concerns.
The head veterinarian and staff were all very kind and I felt I could trust them. ✨
Most importantly, my dog ​​was calmer and more relaxed than at any other hospital I've been to. 🐕 I plan to continue using their services!

It lives up to the wonderful reviews.
The atmosphere in the clinic is friendly and the doctor's communication skills are outstanding.
Since it's the pet owners who choose the hospital and continue to visit, keeping them happy is important, but...the ladies in Osaka love to chat idly!! So if you end up listening to their irrelevant chatter, the waiting time for your appointment will be long.
The doctor's voice, which resonates like a stage actor's without a microphone, was painful to the ears in the small clinic...

Previously, my pet budgie got stuck in a mouse trap, and I took him to the vet.

There are very few vets nearby that treat budgies, so I was grateful just to find one, but I was truly relieved by the doctor's gentle approach to animals!

I gave my budgie the medicine they gave me, and now he's recovered and is healthy!

I'm so grateful that he was able to see such a caring doctor. Thank you so much!!!

I visited this clinic because the reviews were so good.

After actually going there, I understood why it had such high ratings. There was absolutely no atmosphere that suggested they were asking for reviews, yet I completely understood why everyone naturally wanted to give it 5 stars.

I had my cat examined.

The way the doctor examined my cat and spoke to me was very reassuring, and I'm so glad I had him examine my cat.

The nurses and reception staff were also very kind, and it's a clinic I would definitely want to use again in the future.

My beloved dog passed away a few years ago from old age. We had a regular vet since she was born, but they said she might have heart problems because of her age and offered no treatment. I was worried, but then a friend recommended a good hospital, and I went there immediately.

They quickly diagnosed her with heart problems and treated her. After that, she never had another seizure and passed away peacefully from old age.

The day before her death, she stopped eating and drinking and was almost unconscious, so I took her to the hospital.

The doctor told me that it might be her last day, and she passed away there. She was wearing diapers, but the doctor himself cleaned up her waste without complaint. I was surprised and grateful that he did things that a nurse would normally do.

Afterward, when I was looking online to recommend the hospital to friends, I found out the doctor had opened a new practice nearby. I've been recommending it to everyone I know, telling them it's absolutely excellent.

It has a great reputation in the neighborhood; the doctor and nurses are incredibly kind and caring, and the hospital is known for its compassionate approach to animals. I don't currently own any pets, but if I ever do, I would definitely want to have them examined by you.

I sincerely wish you continued success and prosperity in supporting many animals.

When I contacted them because my beloved rabbit seemed unwell, they came to see him right away. The nurse who was able to handle rabbits was on leave, so the head veterinarian examined him alone, but he was very gentle and explained everything very carefully. I was feeling anxious about the visit, but the doctor's cheerful personality made me feel so much better. Unfortunately, despite the treatment, my rabbit passed away the next day, but I think that knowing the doctor treated him gave my rabbit some peace of mind, and that his pain was alleviated. The nurses were also very kind, and it made me realize that good people attract other good people. I don't feel that way at all right now, but if I ever get another pet, I would like to have him examined at this hospital again. Thank you!

The doctors, nurses, and staff are all kind, cheerful, and attentive, making this a hospital where I feel completely at ease bringing my pet for treatment. I've been receiving care here since my previous hospital, and we've overcome many difficult situations. Now that my pet is a senior, it's healthier than ever. We're aiming for a very long life!

He's a very skilled doctor who can treat dogs, cats, and even exotics like parakeets. My chinchilla had congestion and got better immediately after I brought him in the first time. He also helped my rabbit by immediately clipping its teeth and checking its health! It really makes a difference! He's a very caring and wonderful doctor! I especially recommend him to anyone who owns rabbits, tegus, chinchillas, etc.
Thank you for your review.

This is a hospital where the doctor truly loves animals, and both pet owners and their pets receiving treatment feel happy. I once saw a dog that had come in for a checkup refuse to leave after the examination, causing trouble for its owner.

This hospital is a valuable and very much appreciated resource in this area, as it treats not only dogs and cats but also small animals such as rabbits.

I was anxious because it was my first time, but I received accurate treatment and explanations. My second dog is a rescue dog, and she was having trouble eating because she was losing teeth, so I took her in. The vet did their best to remove the bad teeth and make everything clean. I thought they would just pull them all out, but the vet saved some living teeth, thank you! I heard from a fellow dog owner that the vet is very skilled, so I was lucky to have stumbled upon it. I could tell that the nurses really love animals. The nurses are so cute ❤❦ The vet kept calling out the patients' names, and I wondered if he would ever get it wrong (lol). He's such a sweet person.

I'm seeing him for my guinea pig.
It was my first time seeing a pet and my first time at a veterinary hospital, so I was very nervous, but the doctor was very kind, polite, and accurate. I've only been there three times, but he's a very trustworthy doctor. ^ ^
When I first went, thinking I might have a ureteral stone, I was extremely anxious, but the doctor's quick treatment, firm words, and encouraging, energetic voice and attitude really helped. I felt that he really cares about not only the pets, but also the owners.
He answers any questions I have carefully, and he even chats with me, which helps ease my tension.
I think he really loves animals.
My guinea pig was very scared at first and wouldn't show me any face, but maybe it's the doctor's personality, but after the second visit, he didn't seem as nervous. lol
I felt like the other patients who came for consultations also felt at ease, leaving their pets in his care.

I plan to continue seeing him. ^ ^

That's very helpful.

Thank you.

We've been going to Dr. Nakata since our previous hospital, and our dog loves him and doesn't mind going there. He's a kind and trustworthy doctor. He also helped our cat. Our dog is getting old, so we want to entrust him with his care until the end. It's a bit far now, but we still want to have a good doctor.

The doctor's wish is for this animal hospital to be a place that supports both pets and their families, and I believe this hospital truly lives up to that ideal.
My beloved cats passed away at 19 years and 11 months and 20 years and 5 months old, but the doctor and nurses never gave up until the very end, and they faced each other squarely, trying to do everything they could for them. Even as they weakened, they looked me in the eyes and desperately tried to appear healthy, and although I didn't want to accept it, I felt that their end was approaching. I couldn't sleep, and I was at my breaking point mentally, but the doctor's and nurses' words, kindness, and cheerfulness were my support. Thanks to them, they were able to pass away surrounded by their family.
As a pet owner, I'm still a novice and lack communication skills, but I was able to get this far thanks to the doctor, nurses, and all the other pet owners I met at the same time. Thank you so much.
I hope that this hospital will continue to be a place that everyone can trust, just as it has been until now.
Thank you for your continued support.

My beloved cat received excellent care here.

She had received a preliminary diagnosis of squamous cell carcinoma at another clinic, and our regular vet at the time told us, "Surgery is not possible, and there's nothing we can do," refusing to even give her an injection.

However, I desperately wanted her to receive at least a painkiller injection to alleviate her suffering, so I went to Nakata Animal Hospital, which is close to my home, and asked them to give her one.

I thought my cat wouldn't last a week, but she ended up living for three months and two weeks.

I think the doctor's injection formulation was just right for her; after the injection, she would become energetic, wanting to play with toys and asking for food.

Ultimately, her tongue and throat were affected by the cancer, her tongue was almost unrecognizable, and she passed away after two weeks without eating or drinking.

The doctor and nurses are all cheerful and energetic. While some reviews mention their voices being loud, I was truly helped by their cheerfulness.

Knowing that my beloved pet was nearing the end of its life and only receiving life support was incredibly disheartening. However, the hospital staff were so kind and communicative, talking to me so much and saying how cute my pet was, that I actually looked forward to going there.

That was such a huge source of support for me. I felt it was the doctors' thoughtfulness in trying to lift my spirits by being so cheerful.

I am truly grateful.

This is the first hospital I've ever wanted to continue visiting.

I hope you will continue to take good care of your health and keep the hospital open for a long time.

Thank you so much to the doctors and nurses. My pet is surely grateful too.

Thank you for everything.

I always rely on them to take care of my dog.
The vet is a cheerful and bright person, and I appreciate their kind and easy-to-understand explanations.

It was a hospital I'd been curious about because it was nearby. I decided to go there because of the overwhelmingly positive reviews. My pet's condition was worrying, but they examined him carefully and the treatment seemed to be going well. However, one morning his condition suddenly worsened, and when I called to make an appointment, they said the earliest available slot was in two hours. I was worried about waiting two hours, so I took a taxi to a more distant hospital and he was admitted as an emergency case. He passed away that evening. More than wondering if he could have been saved if we had been seen sooner, I was disappointed by the impersonal, purely bureaucratic response to my appointment. It might have been understandable if it was my first visit, but since we had been there several times, I wish they had been a little more flexible in dealing with a sudden change in condition.

The energy level was way too high...
While being cheerful and articulate is refreshing and good for the service industry,
for people who are worried about their sick pets, the loud voice and beaming smile felt inappropriate. The space is small, so you enter and immediately the examination is open to the public, and everything is audible. At the very least, the doctor should lower the volume of their voice.

We've been taking care of our cat since it was a kitten.

You've patiently answered all our detailed questions, which has given us peace of mind.

Thank you so much!

We look forward to your continued support! ^_^

I've had my chinchilla for a year, but it suddenly got injured. I went to the vet I'd been to before, but the vet who specializes in small animals was on vacation.
I looked around for other options and found Tanaka Animal Hospital, so I called them.
The person who answered the phone was very nice, and they said there would be a short wait.
It's a really nice hospital, and the vet, even though it was their first time seeing my chinchilla, examined it carefully and gave a clear explanation.
I was so relieved to hear that its bones weren't broken.
There aren't many vets that treat chinchillas, so I'm really glad I found such a good one.
Thank you very much.

The doctor who saved Rin-chan's life.

He is a truly wonderful person who examines her carefully and kindly.

I own a Corgi, and I've been taking him to Dr. Nakata since he was a puppy. I took him in for his usual care (nail trimming and anal gland expression), and also had his worsening pyoderma checked. He also gave my dog ​​an allergy injection, which only Dr. Nakata knows how to treat. Both the doctor and the nurses were very efficient, and my usually wild dog was very calm. I'm very satisfied because they did all the treatments I wanted done. It's a bit far, but this is my only choice for a veterinarian.
I asked them to trim the nails of my rowdy cat. They are efficient and kind.
Thank you for posting your review.
Thank you for posting your review.

I brought my dog ​​in because he wasn't feeling well.

Since I had an appointment, we were able to see him right away, and they spent the full time with us, which was great.

The amount of medication prescribed was appropriate, and they explained everything carefully, including the ultrasound, which put my mind at ease.

Also, everyone there was wonderful, and they talked to my dog ​​a lot.
She is a very kind teacher, and I see her every month.

You saved my dog ​​who had eaten a cigarette.

I'm so grateful that you accepted him before the clinic's opening hours, even though it was my first time.

Thank you so much! 😭✨
Thank you for your review.

I've been a patient of Dr. Nakata since his time at Fukui Veterinary Clinic, and when I heard he was opening his own practice, I looked him up online and found his current clinic. It's further away than Fukui Veterinary Clinic, but I can't imagine going to any other doctor, so I continue to go there. He's a very trustworthy doctor who has taken care of my current dog and all the dogs I've had in the past. Dr. Nakata's explanations are very thorough and easy to understand, and the fees are reasonable. Both the doctor and the nurses put the animals first and are very supportive of the owners, so I feel completely at ease leaving my pet in their care. I visited other hospitals before meeting Dr. Nakata, but I couldn't find anyone better. I want to continue going to Dr. Nakata for a long time to come. But it's a bit far!
Thank you for your review.

My American Shorthair cat, Momo, went to Nakata Animal Hospital for a heart examination. Another hospital had repeatedly said there was a possibility of myocardial hypertrophy and required an ultrasound under general anesthesia, but Dr. Nakata examined her heart with a point ultrasound without anesthesia. He said everything was fine, and it was the most reassuring day. Momo, who usually bites and acts up, was relaxed the whole time thanks to the gentleness of the assistant. This is the best hospital with clear explanations.
Thank you for your review.

Thank you for your continued support.
My two cats are still healthy and happy at the age of 19, and that's all thanks to Dr. Nakata. …
I had my budgie treated by this doctor when he was working as a hospital physician. …

This was my first visit for rabbit treatment.

Both the doctor and the receptionist were very kind and listened patiently to my …
I was given a thorough examination during my first visit.

Thank you so much for taking care of my large dog the other day! I really appreciate the kind and lengthy consultation. I'm sure we'll be visiting many more times in the future, so I hope we can continue to work together for a long time.
